:::{#exm-pois-two-group-wald}
#### Wald test for a two-cohort rate ratio

To test $H_0: \b_1 = 0$
(equal event rates in the two cohorts of @exm-pois-two-group-mle),
use $\eb_1 \approx 0.693$ and $\ese{\eb_1} \approx 0.387$
from @exm-pois-two-group-ci:

$$
\ba
z
&= \frac{\eb_1 - 0}{\ese{\eb_1}}
&& \text{(Wald } z \text{-statistic with } \b_{1,0} = 0 \text{)} \\
&= \frac{0.693}{0.387}
&& \text{(substitute)} \\
&\approx 1.79
&& \text{(divide)}
\ea
$$

The two-sided $p$-value is
$2 \cdot \P(Z > 1.79) \approx 0.074$,
where $Z$ has a standard Gaussian distribution,
so at the 5% level these data do not reject equal rates.
That conclusion agrees with the 95% confidence interval for the rate ratio in @exm-pois-two-group-ci,
which includes 1.

:::
